newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak to visit Libya for trade talks.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak to visit Libya for trade talks.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak is due to leave for Libya on Thursday for two days of talks with Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi and other officials on trade cooperation, government sources said on Wednesday.

They said Mubarak would attend the meetings of the joint Egyptian-Libyan committee which is due to discuss setting up a free trade zone between the two north African countries and other joint projects.

Mubarak has to travel into Libya by land because the United Nations imposed an air embargo and other sanctions on Libya after it refused to hand over two Libyans suspected of involvement in the bombing of a Pan Am airliner over Lockerbie, Scotland in 1988.
Mubarak said last month the sanctions against Libya had gone on for too long and risked becoming meaningless.
